name: pi-agent-web
description: A local web workbench for Pi Coding Agent's RPC mode with a supervisor gateway and browser UI.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pi-agent-web/protocol build && pnpm --filter @pi-agent-web/server build && pnpm -r test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pi-agent-web/protocol build && pnpm --filter @pi-agent-web/server build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
